defect: The final-integration predecessor scan treated later-created open PRs with a successful merge-readiness check as predecessors of an earlier candidate. This caused PR #859 to wait on later PR #860 and previously caused PR #856 to wait on later PR #857.
root_cause: findPassedPredecessor scanned every open PR targeting main except self, without enforcing predecessor nomination order.
bounded_fix: Only an earlier PR number may be considered a predecessor lease owner. A later PR is explicitly ignored as NON_PREDECESSOR before check or ancestry evaluation. Stable-main guards, exact-final assurance, four-minute bounded wait for genuine earlier predecessors, read-only permissions and no-parallel-merge remain unchanged.
acceptance: regression proves later PR cannot own predecessor lease
genuine earlier green predecessor path remains present
rollback: Revert only the predecessor-order guard and its regression test; preserve all failure evidence and existing serialized/stable-main guards.
